FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Fresh Fare Market, our core operations focus on providing a diverse selection of fresh, frozen, and packaged foods to meet the needs of our community. We operate in a retail space of over 3,000 square feet, ensuring that we maintain established risk management protocols and comply with local and federal food safety regulations. Our team is dedicated to ensuring quality and safety, which includes regular employee training in food handling, sanitation practices, and emergency procedures. We conduct routine inspections and maintain proper refrigeration for all perishable goods to prevent spoilage and foodborne illness. Additionally, we implement pest control measures and sanitation procedures to create a clean and organized shopping environment, minimizing slip and fall hazards. Our commitment to quality extends to our partnerships with reputable vendors who meet our stringent food safety and quality standards. With a focus on customer satisfaction and safety, we strive to be a reliable source of groceries in the Springfield area.
